title: Two consecutive identical will-check rolls at the Cinderhall chapterhouse ('press him on the Hundred') both came back exactly d20:7+2=9 before a third attempt finally succeeded — not necessarily a bug, but the repeat-on-fail loop with no cost shown made it unclear whether retrying was 'free' or whether the earlier failed attempt's Ironbound reputation loss was being re-applied each time.
